leadText:
Squallville (Japanese: ウインドタウン Wind Town) is an -exclusive location in the Sinnoh region. Strong wind currents frequently blow through the area, hence its name. It is also surrounded by mountains and cliffs.

It was featured in Pursuing a Lofty Goal!. A PokéRinger competition was held in the town in which , Paul, and James competed. Ash won the competition, with his evolving into .
